instruction: Turn on my HooliWork notifications so I don't miss anything important. For the sales, general, random, and party-planning-committee channels, make sure each channel's notification preference is set to 'all messages' (flip anything that isn't already there). Bookmark ten important messages across those channels while you're in there, and start a new thread in random about Pretzel Day to build hype.
required_subtasks: Open HooliWork and navigate to #sales; open the channel preferences panel and switch notification_pref to 'all'
Navigate to #general and switch notification_pref to 'all'
Navigate to #random and switch notification_pref to 'all'
Navigate to #party-planning-committee and switch notification_pref to 'all'
Bookmark 2-3 important messages in each of the 4 channels (total >=10)
In #random start a new thread titled or about 'Pretzel Day' and post an opening hype message
Verify the notification settings, bookmarks, and thread all persist after refresh

rubrics.criterion: Agent ensures the HooliWork #sales channel notification_pref is set to 'all' via the channel preferences panel (flipping it if it is not already 'all', or verifying + keeping it at 'all' if it already is)

Agent ensures the HooliWork #general channel notification_pref is set to 'all' via the channel preferences panel (flipping it if it is not already 'all', or verifying + keeping it at 'all' if it already is)

Agent ensures the HooliWork #random channel notification_pref is set to 'all' via the channel preferences panel (flipping it if it is not already 'all', or verifying + keeping it at 'all' if it already is)

Agent ensures the HooliWork #party-planning-committee channel notification_pref is set to 'all' via the channel preferences panel (flipping it if it is not already 'all', or verifying + keeping it at 'all' if it already is)
Agent saves at least 10 important HooliWork messages as bookmarks spread across the #sales, #general, #random, and #party-planning-committee channels
Agent creates a new HooliWork thread in #random titled or about Pretzel Day
Agent posts an on-topic opening message in the new Pretzel Day thread in #random that mentions Pretzel Day rather than placeholder text
Agent verifies the notification-pref changes on the 4 channels, the 10 bookmarks, and the Pretzel Day thread all persist after a refresh

instruction: Post a Motivational Monday message in our #random channel at work. You know how I like it: World's Best Boss style, kick the team's week off right. Pull a quote or two from my Motivational Quotes Collection in ~/Documents/ as a starting point so it doesn't feel made up.
required_subtasks: Open HooliWork and confirm Michael's #random channel membership
Compose a Motivational Monday message in Michael's voice
Read ~/Documents/Motivational_Quotes_Collection.txt and pull at least one quote as inspiration

rubrics.criterion: Agent reads ~/Documents/Motivational_Quotes_Collection.txt and identifies at least one quote from that source
The posted message incorporates at least one actual quote or faithful excerpt from Motivational_Quotes_Collection.txt, rather than merely citing the filename
Agent posts the completed message in the HooliWork #random channel, not another channel
The message explicitly frames itself as motivation or a kickoff to the work week without depending on the execution weekday
The message uses Michael Scott's over-the-top, self-aggrandizing World's Best Boss motivational voice rather than generic corporate boilerplate

instruction: Post a Pretzel Day countdown for next Monday at 8:00 AM EST in the #party-planning-committee channel at work. Build the hype.
required_subtasks: Compose a Pretzel Day countdown message
Schedule or post the message for next Monday at 8:00 AM EST in #party-planning-committee

rubrics.criterion: Agent navigates to the HooliWork #party-planning-committee channel before composing the message
Agent composes a message that mentions Pretzel Day, reflects the next-Monday 8:00 AM timing named in the request, and uses clear hype language without inventing unsupported event details
Agent posts the completed Pretzel Day planning kickoff as a new message in HooliWork
The posted Pretzel Day planning kickoff appears in #party-planning-committee rather than another channel

date_policy_notes: The task is an immediate supported HooliWork planning kickoff and does not invent or depend on an unseeded Pretzel Day event date.
